content:
After being previewed at the I/O 2026 conference in May, Gemini for macOS is now rolling out advanced voice control features.

Google positions this feature as letting you "speak naturally in any window on your desktop," and introduces two main capabilities.

First is Smart Voice Typing, which can "transcribe spoken content into clean, fitting text." Gemini will automatically remove filler words like "um" and "ah," and will consider mid-sentence corrections to accurately capture what you intend to express.

The formatted text will be automatically inserted at your current cursor position. This will provide a voice-to-text experience similar to the upcoming Gboard Rambler on Gemini Intelligence phones.

The other feature goes beyond simple transcription, understanding the content of your current screen to execute complex tasks. This optional feature requires you to enable Gemini reasoning in the app's settings.

  • Capture and organize information: Highlight local files, images, or documents on your desktop, then tell Gemini what you need. For example, you could say: "Read these veterinary files and write a summary of my dog's medical history into an email to the boarding centre."
  • Write and rewrite text: Highlight text anywhere on your screen, then use voice to instantly rewrite, adjust the tone, and place the polished version exactly where you need it. You could try saying: "Rewrite these notes into an executive summary, and add a TL;DR at the beginning."
  • Generate and edit images: When brainstorming concepts or planning a trip itinerary, use voice to generate visual materials; or refer to existing designs on your desktop and request quick updates. You could try saying: "Based on this illustration, generate a dark mode version."

No matter where you are in macOS, long-press the Fn key to activate, or click the newly added screen share button at the end of the "Ask Gemini" prompt. Gemini will display a floating capsule icon with a soundwave animation at the bottom of the screen.

Please make sure you have updated Gemini for macOS to the latest version (1.88). This new voice feature is rolling out globally, currently supporting English, with more languages "coming soon."
